Summary
: The English translation of the Abhinaya-darpana (“the mirror of gesture”) by Nandikeshvara: an encyclopedic manual of the art of gesticulation. It belongs to a wide range of literature known as Natya-shastra: the ancient Indian art of dramatic performance, theatrics, dance and music. 
The Abhinaya Darpana is an abridgement of the Bharatarnava, a much larger exposition on the art of dancing, containing 4000 shlokas.
The full sanskrit title is Abhinayadarpaṇa (अभिनयदर्पण) by Nandikeśvara.
